title: Zero Trust Branch, EASM, Business Insights, Zero Trust Cellular and Microsegmentation: SDK-built read-only requests, per-product Scope page keys, secrets dropped, offline sample and snapshots, 20 scored checks, the page and its exports

checks.what: SDK_INVENTORY names every public method of the installed SDK's ztb, zeasm, zbi, zcell and zms packages (1.11.3), each once
every read is an SDK list_/get_ method marked read here; writes, TOTP secrets and single provisioning keys are never called; a non-GET other than a listed GraphQL query is refused
captured requests carry the SDK's own paths, camelCased query keys and GraphQL queries (never a mutation)
planted keys, site secrets, tokens, activation codes, TOTP and WireGuard keys reach no report, workbook, JSON or snapshot; dropped on arrival and again before output
report and alert recipients, tracked SIMs and devices are counted, never listed
only ticked products are read; nothing ticked, a malformed customer ID or the classic sign-in is a 400 before any client is built; the route is in the scope-rule table
404 is N/A not licensed (INFO, outside the score), 403 is not permitted, a missing customer ID is not read; never judged
answers of unexpected shapes parse to empty rows; lists capped at 500 rows, text cut; customer IDs are letters, digits, - and _ only
a tenant name starting with = stays quoted text in the workbook
the sample tenant has all five products; a snapshot keeps their answers (ZMS by operation, ZCell id keyed) and opens offline with the same verdicts; offline GraphQL answers only listed queries
the page reads the sample from the keyboard, shows every product, escapes a hostile site name, announces the result and does not scroll sideways at 320px

findings.title: A Microsegmentation agent reported DISCONNECTED matched the word connected and was counted as connected (ZMS.1 passed)
findings.fix: status words are matched whole (anchored), so DISCONNECTED, offline and not_connected are not healthy

findings.title: The report's own keys 'key' and 'api_keys' matched the secret filter, so the list of what was read and the ZTB API key names were silently dropped from the report
findings.fix: the report uses 'list' and 'automation_access'; the secret filter is unchanged

findings.title: dlp_analysis.ScopedClient guarded GETs only: a Microsegmentation GraphQL read (a POST) would have passed the service-scope guard
findings.fix: the guard refuses a POST to /zms/graphql unless Microsegmentation is selected; other POSTs are unchanged

findings.title: A snapshot saved from the live tenant carries Zero Trust Cellular only when a ZCell customer ID is known; the snapshot form has no field for it
findings.fix: the snapshot says so in its unread list; the Other products page and the assessment take the ID; a snapshot field is left for a later change
